# CreditDecide

> CreditDecide is the AI-native underwriting and credit decisioning platform for consumer lenders — personal loans, instalment lending and point-of-sale finance. From application to collections, no code required.

CreditDecide helps consumer lending teams automate borrower intake and KYC, assess income and affordability, apply their own versioned lending policies, and return evidence-backed APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE decisions — then close the loop with collections and outcome calibration. Every decision is explainable: each risk signal traces back to its source field through an evidence graph. The AI underwriter advises; lender policy decides. CreditDecide also speaks the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so compatible AI assistants can retrieve authorized lending data and explore evidence within lender controls. Any country, any currency, with configurable policies and data sources per market.

## Core capabilities

- No-code visual policy builder with rule thresholds and APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE outcomes
- White-label borrower application forms with market-specific KYC
- Live credit bureau and open banking data sources per market, or document upload
- Five risk dimensions: credit, affordability, fraud, data quality, policy
- Structured risk signals with full evidence lineage to source fields
- AI underwriter with advisory recommendations and in-context assistant
- Decision exports as PDF, CSV, and Word; adverse-action notices and reason codes
- Batch and portfolio underwriting from a CSV of applicants
- Collections management to extend the credit lifecycle past the decision
- Post-decision monitoring and outcome calibration feedback loop
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI-assisted, auditable access
- Sandbox and production environment isolation

## Who it's for

Consumer lenders — personal loan providers, instalment lenders, point-of-sale lenders, buy-now-pay-later, digital banks, credit unions, microfinance, retail credit, auto finance, neobanks, savings & loans, and community lenders — in any market worldwide.
